newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 24.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers on Thursday were lower as buyers moved to the sidelines owing to weaker crude prices, traders said. A major said enquiries were very thin. "Shipowners were expecting prices to go even lower and most would rather wait than to buy at current prices," a trader said. But MDO and gas oil prices held steady as demand was healthy, traders said. --
